description: This file implements the JoystickInputMapper class for handling joystick input device mapping, including axis configuration, processing input events, and generating motion notifications within the Android input framework.

classes.name: JoystickInputMapper
classes.description: Handles mapping and processing of joystick input events, including axis configuration, event processing, and device info population.

methods.name: getSources
methods.description: Returns the input source type for joystick devices.

methods.name: populateDeviceInfo
methods.description: Populates device info with axis motion ranges for the joystick.

methods.name: addMotionRange
methods.description: Adds motion range for a specific axis to the device info.

methods.name: getCompatAxis
methods.description: Returns a compatibility axis for a given axis, or -1 if none.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs the internal state of the joystick mapper for debugging.

methods.name: reconfigure
methods.description: Reconfigures the joystick axes based on device and framework state.

methods.name: createAxis
methods.description: Creates an axis object with calculated scaling and limits based on axis info.

methods.name: haveAxis
methods.description: Checks if a specific axis ID is present.

methods.name: pruneAxes
methods.description: Removes excess axes to stay within maximum supported axes.

methods.name: isCenteredAxis
methods.description: Determines if an axis is a centered axis.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Recenters all axes to their default state.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes raw input events and updates axis values accordingly.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Generates motion notification events based on current axis states.

methods.name: setPointerCoordsAxisValue
methods.description: Sets the value of a specific axis in PointerCoords, including compatibility axes.

methods.name: filterAxes
methods.description: Filters axis values to reduce noise and insignificant changes.

methods.name: hasValueChangedSignificantly
methods.description: Determines if an axis value has changed enough to warrant an update.

methods.name: hasMovedNearerToValueWithinFilteredRange
methods.description: Checks if a new axis value is closer to a threshold than the previous value.
